task: cancel a subscription (Netflix, gym and streaming services, app-store subscriptions): sign in, find the buried cancel path in account settings — or the phone's subscription manager — click through the retention offers, confirm; complete when the cancellation confirmation showing the service end date is on screen. Surface pinned: the service's website/app account settings or the phone's subscription-manager screen. Variants: pausing or downgrading a plan, deleting the account entirely, and disputing a charge do not belong.

questions.question: Do different parts of your account agree on your subscription status?
questions.why: The screen showed conflicting information about the active subscription tier across different sections.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the ability to notice discrepancies in their account status that might indicate a billing error.
questions.check: do different sections of the account show the same subscription tier/status, or do they disagree
questions.say_example: The account page and the billing page name different tiers for the same subscription - <Premium> on one, <Standard> on the other

questions.question: Do all the dates shown for when your access, billing, or trial ends agree with each other across every screen you've seen?
questions.why: The displayed next payment date fluctuated between April 14 and April 15 across the account overview, membership page, and cancellation steps.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the chance to spot platform glitches regarding your billing cycle that might affect your actual service end date.
questions.check: do the dates shown for service ending, next billing, or trial expiry agree with each other across every screen and step seen so far
questions.say_example: The dates don't agree - the account page says <14 March>, the billing page says a different date

questions.question: Does the name of the canceled subscription exactly match the active one you intended to cancel?
questions.why: The confirmation screen showed an inactive 'PRO' subscription instead of the active 'PRO+' one, indicating the wrong subscription might have been canceled.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the certainty that their specific active subscription was actually terminated and might continue being billed for it.
questions.check: does the name of the subscription shown as cancelled exactly match the one you picked to cancel
questions.say_example: The confirmation names <a different tier> than the one you picked, <your tier>

questions.question: After that survey closes, does the subscription still show as active with a future payment date?
questions.why: The screen showed the subscription remaining active with a future payment date after the survey closed, indicating the cancellation may not have been finalized.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user risks being charged for another billing cycle if the agent assumes the process is complete without verifying the final cancellation status.
questions.check: After the survey closed, does the subscription still show active with a future payment date?
questions.say_example: After that survey, this still shows active with a payment due <date> - the cancellation may not have gone through

questions.question: Do the details in the cancellation confirmation actually match the subscription you are trying to cancel?
questions.why: The screen shows a static gallery screenshot of a different app's renewal date rather than a live cancellation confirmation.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the certainty that their specific subscription was successfully canceled if the agent accepts a mismatched or static image as proof.
questions.check: does the confirmation shown actually name the subscription you're cancelling, or does it look like a stale or generic screenshot for a different app
questions.say_example: That confirmation names a different app's renewal date, not <your subscription> - it doesn't look like a live confirmation

questions.question: Did the cancellation fail with a system error or a prompt to call customer support?
questions.why: Sometimes the final 'Cancel' button throws a generic error or requires a phone call to complete, meaning the auto-billing is still active.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user risks assuming the task is done and being billed again because the agent didn't flag the system failure.
questions.check: did the cancellation attempt end in a system error or a prompt to call customer support instead of a confirmation
questions.say_example: That ended in <a system error>, not a confirmation - billing may still be active

questions.question: Does this page say a cancellation confirmation email is coming?
questions.why: On-screen confirmations can be lost once closed, so checking your email for a receipt ensures you have evidence to dispute future erroneous charges.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the verifiable paper trail needed to fight a chargeback if the company's system fails to honor the cancellation.
questions.check: does the confirmation say a cancellation email will be sent
questions.say_example: This page says a cancellation email is on its way - worth checking your inbox for it, in case you need proof later.

questions.question: Do you want to provide a reason for canceling?
questions.why: The cancellation confirmation page includes a survey asking why you ended your membership.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to provide feedback to the company about why you are leaving.
questions.verify_form: A post-cancel survey asked why you left - check whether the agent answered and what it said; the survey is optional and whatever went in speaks in your name.
questions.check: does the post-cancellation screen ask for a reason, and is it optional
questions.say_example: This exit survey is optional - want me to answer it, or just close it?

questions.question: Do you want to provide written feedback about why you canceled, or just close the confirmation screen?
questions.why: The screen confirms your cancellation was successful and provides an optional text box to share feedback or feature suggestions.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to provide personal feedback to the company about why their service no longer meets your needs.
questions.verify_form: A free-text feedback box followed the cancellation - check whether the agent typed anything into it; words submitted there are yours.
questions.check: does the confirmation screen offer an optional free-text feedback box
questions.say_example: There's an optional feedback box here too - want to add anything, or just close it?
